name: Database Backup (SQLite / PostgreSQL)
description: Back up a SQLite file or a PostgreSQL database into a timestamped file and keep only the newest N backups. The PostgreSQL password is passed as an environment variable.

parameters.name: database
parameters.label: Database file or name
parameters.help: SQLite: the full path of the file. PostgreSQL: the database name.

parameters.name: keep
parameters.label: Backups to keep
parameters.help: Older backups of the same database are deleted.

parameters.name: password
parameters.label: PostgreSQL password
parameters.help: Sent as the PGPASSWORD environment variable, not on the command line. Not saved in presets.
